title: Sadaqat al-fitr
intro: The special Eid charity that purifies our fast and feeds the poor.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: Ibn ‘Abbas (RA) said: “The Messenger of Allah (SAW) prescribed sadaqat al-fitr to purify the fast from careless and indecent words, and to feed the poor.” (Abu Dawud)

In the days of Ramadan, Allah (SWT) prescribed fasting, which makes Muslims more mindful of Allah and brings them closer to their Lord. In those days Muslims are especially caring towards the weak, the poor, the sick and the tired members of their community.

Sadaqat al-fitr is a special act of worship, prescribed in the second year after the Hijrah, and given in the last days of Ramadan. It is the Eid charity, given so that our fast is cleaned of any shortcomings.

Sadaqat al-fitr is given for every Muslim – adult or child. An adult gives it for himself and for everyone he is responsible for providing for in his family. It is also good to give it for a baby who is not yet born.

items: The person has more food than they and their family need on the night before Eid and on the day of Eid.

learn.html: Like zakah, sadaqat al-fitr is given to the Baytul-mal fund, which helps the groups named in the 60th ayah of Surah At-Tawbah (Qur’an, At-Tawbah 9:60). Muslims in Bosnia and Herzegovina give their sadaqat al-fitr to the Baytul-mal and so make their Community stronger in their homeland. In our community, the Imam can explain how sadaqat al-fitr is collected here and how much it is.

items: In the last days of Ramadan, and at the latest before the Eid prayer.
Sadaqat al-fitr given after the Eid prayer counts only as ordinary sadaqah.
Whoever delays it on purpose is sinful, and it stays a debt that they must still give later.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: When Ramadan ends, our fast needs to be cleaned of the small mistakes that did not spoil it but lessened its value. The Prophet Muhammad (SAW) said: “The fast of Ramadan stays held between the earth and the heavens until the believer gives sadaqat al-fitr.” (As-Suyuti) Let’s use this blessing from Allah so that our fast is complete and goes to Allah (SWT) as pure worship.
